decisions.reason: Weekly reassessment. The fetched page (2026-11-13, new hash) now carries the title "About local sandboxing for GitHub Copilot" and mainly covers local sandboxing. It still describes cloud sandboxing as remote, isolated, and usage-billed. It states no lifecycle stage, so public preview is not re-confirmed. No tenant, policy, audit, or retention evidence was fetched. Gates stay unknown. Human dates are not renewed.

citations.quote: Run an entire Copilot session remotely, inside a fully isolated, ephemeral Linux environment hosted by GitHub. Cloud sandboxing is billed based on usage.
